Now we have the reactionary establishment and privileged actors pushing this case all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court, demanding absolute immunity for disruptive behavior while real systemic inequalities affecting marginalized students are swept under the rug. This is just a push by those who want to protect coded vulgarity and disrespect while ignoring the authority of public educators to maintain a proper learning space.
